# Translated into Arabic (TIA)

> Translated into Arabic (TIA), founded in 2026, is the translation and localization practice of Ahmed Alzamli, a Palestinian translator working from English, French and Spanish into Arabic. Translating since 2011 and professionally since 2014, he helps businesses and translation agencies reach Arabic-speaking audiences with accurate, natural Arabic for websites, software, marketing and specialized documents.

- Owner and translator: Ahmed Alzamli (also written Ahmed Alzamly; Arabic: أحمد الزاملي)
- Languages: English, French and Spanish into Arabic
- Based in: Palestine; works with clients worldwide, remotely
- Education: Bachelor's degree in Environmental Engineering, Islamic University of Gaza (2014); Diploma in Translation, University College of Applied Sciences (UCAS), Gaza (2018); Diploma in Digital Marketing, UCAS, Gaza (2026)
- Credentials and memberships: ProZ.com Certified PRO; member of the Arabic Translators Association; volunteer with Translators without Borders, ProZ Pro Bono and Global Voices
- Tools: SDL Trados Studio, memoQ, Wordfast, Xbench
- Client reviews: https://www.proz.com/profile/2522215
- Contact: ahmed@artranslated.com, +970 594 808 782 (WhatsApp and Telegram)
- Site languages: English (/en), Arabic (/ar), French (/fr), Spanish (/es)

## Services

- [Translation into Arabic](https://www.artranslated.com/en/services/translation): professional human translation from English, French and Spanish, with translation, editing and proofreading (TEP)
- [Editing & Proofreading](https://www.artranslated.com/en/services/editing): bilingual editing, proofreading and LQA scoring of Arabic translations, including other translators' work, for clients and agencies
- [Machine translation post-editing (MTPE)](https://www.artranslated.com/en/services/mtpe): light and full post-editing of machine-translated Arabic
- [Transcreation & UI copy](https://www.artranslated.com/en/services/transcreation): marketing, app and website copy adapted for Arabic audiences
- [Consulting](https://www.artranslated.com/en/services/consulting): advice on entering Arabic-speaking markets, terminology, style guides and localization workflow
- [Digital Marketing](https://www.artranslated.com/en/services/digital-marketing): Arabic SEO, social media, ads and email content
